summary: Frontend-only typography regression pass executed on public preview. Domain scripts and TypeScript checks pass. Scoped typography behavior is correct on Home/Classic config/Maracana config/Live screens, with timer/score hierarchy confirmed at 390 and 320 widths. Minor truncation remains on narrow layouts for some labels with active session and long team names.

ui_bugs.component: Home mode cards + resume card at small widths
ui_bugs.issue: At ~320 width, text is visibly ellipsized (e.g., mode title 'Match classique' and resume text). No overlap, but readability drops.
Long team names are aggressively truncated in side columns on live screen (expected by layout constraints, but readability impact is visible).

integration_issues.flow: Expo web preview stability during extended Playwright flow
integration_issues.issue: Intermittent Metro disconnect/502 appeared once during automation run; subsequent reruns passed and app remained testable.

issues: Typography remains balanced globally, but card labels lose full readability due ellipsis when session resume block is present.

action_items: Review optional text fitting strategy for narrow widths (320) on Home cards/resume area if full labels are required without ellipsis.
If desired, add deterministic fallback for long live team names (abbreviation policy) to improve legibility.
Investigate occasional Metro disconnect noise in preview environment (non-blocking, reproducible only intermittently).
critical_code_review_comments: Typography scoping is correctly contained: Cup screen uses original aliases (Manrope-Bold/Manrope-Medium), section labels remain 12px uppercase, and shared PrimaryButton outside refined provider stays 19px.
Refined screens correctly load ManropeRefined aliases (500/700) and show stronger hierarchy for title/section/CTA.

Some testIDs (e.g., home-wordmark/mode-card-cup) can resolve multiple elements in web rendering during transitions, making automation waits flaky; unique IDs per visible node would improve test robustness.
seed_data_creation: None. Used fresh browser sessions for independent mode checks.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated requested scope only: Home, Live, Classic config, Maracana config + containment checks for Cup. Timer metrics verified: ~104px at 390 and ~76.4px at 320. Score metrics verified: ~70.2px at 390 and ~57.6px at 320. CTA 'Fin du match' at width 320 uses 16px and was not truncated. Pause/resume, +1 scoring, correction -1, giant chrono open/close, and home resume flow worked. Cup scope check confirms unchanged typography alias behavior.
rca_of_issue: RCA (minor): truncation at narrow widths is caused by fixed-width/one-line rendering constraints (numberOfLines=1 with side-column width limits and card text area). No functional regression or overlap detected; issue is visual/readability-only for long labels.
